from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,yaml
ROOT=Path.cwd()
R31="reports/research/510300_bank_release_vintage_and_nim_definition_probe_v1"
R32="reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_source_and_prior_use_probe_v1"
OUT=ROOT/R32
assert not OUT.exists(),"E32目录已存在，不覆盖"
proposal=json.loads((ROOT/R31/"next_experiment.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert proposal["experiment_id"]=="E32" and proposal["provider_api_collection_in_this_proposed_source_stage"] is False
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for x in proposal["references"]:assert sha(ROOT/x["path"])==x["sha256"]
OUT.mkdir()
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
snapshot={}
for rel in ["config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json","config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json"]:
 p=ROOT/rel;snapshot[rel]={"captured_at":now,"sha256":sha(p),"config":json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))}
(OUT/"原研究权限与账户口径快照.json").write_text(json.dumps(snapshot,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
rate_contract_path="config/510300_asymmetric_stress_hazard_v1_dr007_tushare_v1_0_2.yaml"
y=yaml.safe_load((ROOT/rate_contract_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
(OUT/"旧利率源_原协议已存字段.json").write_text(json.dumps({"path":rate_contract_path,"sha256":sha(ROOT/rate_contract_path),
 "fields_requested_by_original_parser":["ts_code","trade_date","repo_maturity","weight"],
 "value_semantics":"WEIGHTED_AVERAGE_RATE_PERCENT","new_transaction_amount_not_admitted_by_old_rate_contract":True,
 "old_research_authority_not_inherited":True,"credentials_read_or_copied":False},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
extra=[R31+"/next_experiment.json",R32+"/原研究权限与账户口径快照.json",R32+"/旧利率源_原协议已存字段.json",rate_contract_path]
parents=proposal["references"]+[{"path":p,"sha256":sha(ROOT/p)} for p in extra]
queries=[{"q":"site:tushare.pro repo_daily DR007 amount 成交金额","domains":["tushare.pro"]},
 {"q":"site.chinamoney.com.cn DR007 成交量 统计 利率债 质押","domains":["chinamoney.com.cn"]}]
queries[1]["q"]="DR007 成交量 统计 利率债 质押"
protocol={"study_id":proposal["proposed_study_id"],"experiment_id":"E32","registered_at":now,
 "previous_goal_turn_classification":"PROGRESS_E31_NEW_Q2_DATED_BODY_FOUR_ROUNDED_POINT_VALUES_AND_METHOD_MISMATCH_COMPLETED",
 "question":proposal["question"],"hypothesis":proposal["economic_hypothesis"],
 "candidate_identity_frozen":proposal["candidate_identity_frozen"],
 "budget":proposal["proposed_budget"],"directory_queries_frozen":queries,
 "source_stage_only":True,"provider_api_collection":False,
 "admission_support":proposal["acceptance_support"],"source_rule":proposal["source_rule"],
 "known_old_families":proposal["known_old_families"],
 "allowed_primary_source_hosts":["tushare.pro","chinamoney.com.cn","pbc.gov.cn"],
 "stop_conditions":["来源只说明全市场或R007成交额而非DR007统计样本则不准入，不改身份。",
 "字段没有同身份/单位/时钟或原完整成熟成员支持则本源门未过；不缩样本、填零、重新查旧失败URL。",
 "最多2查询/4条新唯一直链；不调用带凭据API、不新增服务支付、不改旧采集代码。",
 "来源门通过前不拟合；当前研究不生成前瞻、账户或订单。"],
 "parents":parents,"new_fits":0,"new_training_labels":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,
 "net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","orders_authorized":False,"new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False,
 "goal_achieved":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET"}
(OUT/"protocol.json").write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"登记实验":"E32同DR007成交额来源/旧用途","冻结父文件":len(parents),"来源预算":"2查询/4直链","带凭据API":False,"新增模型":0,"目标":"未达"},ensure_ascii=False))
